description.zh: 同步至指定地域的数组列表。若包含'all'，则默认同步至所有其它未同步地域。
description.en: The list of arrays that are synchronized to the specified region. If 'all' is included, it is synchronized to all other unsynchronized regions by default.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ehpcinstant synchronize-app --app-id ci-vm-rYfypJKwlN9Y --target-region-ids cn-shanghai --region cn-hangzhou
